prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: low-speed head-on collision. Injury: neck strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1408; do not mention it.)
text:
We write regarding our client, [CLIENT_NAME], who was injured in a motor vehicle collision on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was lawfully operating their vehicle when the other driver, insured under your policy, crossed the center line and struck our client's vehicle head-on. Liability for this collision rests squarely with your insured, whose negligence caused the impact.

Although the collision occurred at a low rate of speed, the force of impact was sufficient to cause our client a cervical strain. Following the accident, our client experienced persistent neck pain, stiffness, and reduced range of motion, and was advised to undergo physical therapy and follow-up care. Our client has done everything asked of them to recover, and continues to experience symptoms that affect daily activities, sleep, and work.

Our client's medical expenses to date, together with lost time from work and the pain and inconvenience suffered, support the compensation outlined below. We request that your company resolve this claim in the amount of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] within thirty days of the date of this letter. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will consider filing suit to recover full damages.
